proposedEntry.name: localization-design
proposedEntry.description: Makes the agent design UI that survives localization: text-expansion planning with per-language percentages (German +20-35%, Finnish +30-40%), RTL mirroring rules including what does and does not mirror, CSS logical properties, typography rules for Arabic/CJK/Indic scripts, cultural color and iconography tables, locale-aware date/number/address formats, and design-system implications (semantic 'start/end' token naming, pseudo-localization testing).
